verdict: WSUS client scan is taking hours instead of minutes. Expired definition updates and malware-cleanup revisions have not been declined on the WSUS/SUP server, bloating the update metadata the client must evaluate.
fix: On the WSUS server, open the WSUS console -> `Options -> Automatic Approvals -> Advanced`. Enable `Automatically approve new revisions of approved updates` and `Automatically decline updates when a new revision causes them to expire`. Then run the WSUS server cleanup wizard (or `Invoke-WsusServerCleanup -DeclineExpiredUpdates -DeclineSupersededUpdates -CleanupUnneededContentFiles`) to clear the existing bloat. Re-index SUSDB after cleanup.
